title: Holding Company Seeking Loan in Geneva, Switzerland
tagline: Swiss-sponsored permanent-capital holding (no fixed liquidation date) that acquires and builds profitable service businesses for the long term (20-30 year horizon). We are raising financing for the first programmes of the platform. - Two anchor programmes run in parallel: (A) an integrated Swiss healthcare network expanding to the Gulf and Europe, and (B) a majority investment in a leading independent European accounting & advisory network. - Two enabling programmes: a proprietary technology layer (ERP, billing and capital-management tools) and a healthcare real-estate company holding the clinic premises. - One SPV per programme: financing can back the whole platform or a single programme. - Built IPO-ready from day one (IFRS, Big 4 audit, listed-company governance). IPO remains an option, never an obligation. - First closing targeted H1 of next year; closings are modular (one programme or several). - Company is an investment holding company: it carries out no activity subject to authorisation and provides no investment services. Licences are held at operating-company level where the sector requires them: cantonal health authorisations for our medical practitioners and clinics, and professional registrations for accounting and fiduciary services. Images. We have added a programme visual to each of our listings. - The holding itself is not required to register with the Swiss financial regulator, as it provides no financial services to third parties. Our raise is addressed to professional and qualified investors mainly, and is structured with legal counsel accordingly.
